sloka: तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा मारीचः काश्यपः तदा ।प्रत्युवाच महातेजा दितिम् परम दुःखिताम् ॥१-४६-४॥
transliteration: tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā mārīcaḥ kāśyapaḥ tadā ।pratyuvāca mahātejā ditim parama duḥkhitām ॥1-46-4॥

translations.english: Then, Maricha's son, exceedingly bright Kasyapa on hearing the words of Diti who was deeply grieved replied:
